en: Sepia-toned street scene showing a rural procession or market day. In the foreground a man and woman in traditional peasant clothing walk beside a handcart piled with belongings, while another woman leads a cow on a rope. A dog runs toward the camera. In the background, multiple horse-drawn carts and people in similar dress move along an unpaved road lined with wooden poles and simple wooden buildings, with trees further back. A small number, "2084", is printed in the lower left corner, but no caption is visible.
